approach.mechanism: The client app keeps ONE QUIC connection; when its local address changes it sends from the new address with a fresh connection ID; the server validates the new path (PATH_CHALLENGE/RESPONSE) and continues the same streams.
approach.name: QUIC connection migration
approach.recovery_point: first new data delivered to the mobile node after the address change (path validation is not exposed by the aioquic API)
approach.scope_limits: Works only for applications that use QUIC. It does NOT make arbitrary TCP applications mobile.
approach.status: Real QUIC engine (aioquic) in the emulator (RFC 9000 section 9 connection migration). Requires aioquic.

reason: quic-migration in the loopback (real sockets) environment: no loopback QUIC harness implemented (the emulator drives aioquic in virtual time instead)
support: no loopback QUIC harness implemented (the emulator drives aioquic in virtual time instead)
